title: A garment, worn, then moving
pitch: An invented model and a garment on a hanger in. The model wearing it, walking toward you, with a score, out.
why: Try-on and motion are different problems. One model keeps the coat's length and buttons on the same person, and H3 then makes the cloth move.

fields.label: The model
fields.default: an invented woman in her thirties with short dark curly hair, plain white t-shirt and blue jeans, white sneakers

fields.label: The garment
fields.default: a long emerald green wool coat with a wide collar and four gold buttons

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1 with the Outfit Swap LoRA
models.licence: Qwen-Image 2.1's own licence; the LoRA is rent-only at its source

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.note: Commercial use must show the name MiniMax-Music3.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Invented people only: this stage has no face or identity input by design.

steps.label: The model

57:27.text: Full body fashion photograph of {person}, standing facing the camera, the whole figure in frame with both hands visible, in a sunlit stone courtyard, soft daylight, 50mm lens. No text, no logos.

steps.does: An invented person, whole figure in frame.

steps.label: The garment

57:27.text: Product photograph of {garment} on an invisible mannequin, the whole garment in frame, plain light grey studio background, even soft light. No text, no logos, no labels.

steps.does: The garment alone, ready to be worn.

steps.label: Worn
steps.model: Qwen-Image 2.1 with the Outfit Swap LoRA
steps.does: The same person, wearing the coat, with its length and buttons kept.

steps.label: The clip
steps.does: The cloth moves, the person stays the same.
steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Fashion film. The woman walks slowly toward the camera across the sunlit courtyard. The long coat swings with each step. Her arms stay relaxed at her sides. The camera tracks backward with her at walking speed. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
